attestations.text: MU-chang-a 穆彰阿 (T. 子樸, H. 常軒, 鶴舫), 1782–1856, official, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner. His father, Kuang-t'ai 廣泰 (d. 1825), was a sub-chancellor of the Grand Secretariat.
穆彰阿，字鶴舫，郭佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.
Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 穆彰阿，字鶴舫，郭佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。父廣泰，嘉慶中，官內閣學士，遷右翼總兵。坐自請兼兵部侍郎銜，奪職。
